slug: 2024-09-17 DPI Safeguards come online in Zambias next phase of digital integration

ZMB.note: No exchange between civil register and ID system is stated.

facts.fact: UNDP says INRIS has enrolled 1.5 million people with biometrics; against the 21.9 million population held here that is about 6.8% (the source gives no population share and says 9 million adults).

ZMB.note: A unique legal ID number is planned but not tied to birth registration.
No statement on who operates or owns the platform.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: UNDP says the DNRPC has built INRIS and enrolled 1.5 million people with biometrics, is in the strategy and design stage, and will introduce a unique legal ID number while the old system is phased out.
